inferred.asserted: erratum 20240730_sau3-1 (malformed_line): read as "D. Woodcox reached on a fielder's choice; T. Lozano advanced to third, scored on an error by ss, unearned.". A runner who has already scored cannot then advance, and this clause says he does both: 'advanced to third, scored on an error by ss, advanced on an error by c'. No other line in the corpus puts an 'advanced on an error by X' fragment after a scoring clause for the same runner. The published linescore gives the home side 1 run in inning 2, which Lozano's single run already accounts for, so the trailing fragment adds nothing the linescore wants. Woodcox, the only other runner on the play, is shown still on first by his own next line ('out at second c to ss, caught stealing'), so the fragment cannot belong to him either.
inferred.raw: D. Woodcox reached on a fielder's choice; T. Lozano advanced to third, scored on an error by ss, advanced on an error by c, unearned.
